'''2018 EGP Charlie Arlandson LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Charlie Arlandson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Old Allies / We Need Your Help|V4-L-oldallies.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127135112/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
